lessons.text: A targeted natural replay can prove one branch while the default/full sweep still fails; never promote a local PASS to repaired until the exact object-state-renderer-viewport matrix and the complete natural journey pass.

Every authored hazard must be tested as a player decision: normal input must reach its window, collision must produce an attributable failure signal, and a readable avoidance or recovery route must be verified on desktop and mobile.

A natural QA runner must treat preview-server death, frame starvation and stale browser processes as explicit infrastructure evidence with a bounded watchdog; never convert an interrupted run into a gameplay PASS or silently reuse an old report.

Hazard dimensions must be calibrated against the actual normal-input timing envelope: keep a deterministic safe line, a deterministic risk line that fails visibly, and recovery shelves that catch late misses without sealing the route; validate every changed branch on desktop and mobile before closing BLOCKED.
